checkpoints.name: shift_reset_held
checkpoints.description: Reset still asserted; shift register parked at zero, LFSR parked at the seed value 0x01.

checkpoints.name: shift_first_bit
checkpoints.description: First posedge after reset release (t=30) shifts in sin=1; q becomes 0x01.

checkpoints.name: shift_mid_pattern
checkpoints.description: Four bits (1,0,1,1) have been shifted in; q reads 0x0B.

checkpoints.name: shift_full_pattern
checkpoints.description: All 8 bits of the input pattern 1,0,1,1,0,1,0,0 have shifted in. q reads 0xB4 = 10110100 binary; sout (q[7]) reads 1.

checkpoints.name: lfsr_initial
checkpoints.description: LFSR is parked at its seed value 5'b00001 while reset is asserted.

checkpoints.name: lfsr_mid_cycle
checkpoints.description: Halfway through one LFSR period (cycle 12 of 31), state reaches 5'b01111.

checkpoints.name: lfsr_period_returns
checkpoints.description: After 31 clock cycles since the first transition at t=30, state returns to 5'b00001 at t=330. The LFSR period is therefore 310 ns (31 cycles).
